Data.oldValue: NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM C_PaymentProcessorBatch pp INNER JOIN C_PPBatchLine ppl ON(pp.C_PaymentProcessorBatch_ID = ppl.C_PaymentProcessorBatch_ID) WHERE pp.DocStatus NOT IN('VO', 'RE') AND ppl.C_Payment_ID = p.C_Payment_ID) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM C_BankStatement bs WHERE bs.C_BankStatement_ID = bsl.C_BankStatement_ID AND bs.C_BankAccount_ID = @C_BankAccount_ID@) AND p.IsReceipt = 'Y' AND p.IsReconciled = 'Y' AND p.DocStatus IN('CO', 'CL') AND p.Withdrawal_ID IS NOT NULL AND p.Deposit_ID IS NOT NULL

PO.Data: NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM C_PaymentProcessorBatch pp INNER JOIN C_PPBatchLine ppl ON(pp.C_PaymentProcessorBatch_ID = ppl.C_PaymentProcessorBatch_ID) WHERE pp.DocStatus NOT IN('VO', 'RE') AND ppl.C_Payment_ID = p.C_Payment_ID) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM C_BankStatement bs WHERE bs.C_BankStatement_ID = bsl.C_BankStatement_ID AND bs.C_BankAccount_ID IN (SELECT ppb.C_BankAccount_ID FROM C_PPBatchConfigurationLine ppb WHERE ppb.C_PPBatchConfiguration_ID = @C_PPBatchConfiguration_ID@)) AND p.IsReceipt = 'Y' AND p.IsReconciled = 'Y' AND p.DocStatus IN('CO', 'CL') AND p.Withdrawal_ID IS NOT NULL AND p.Deposit_ID IS NOT NULL

The record is active in the system

There are two methods of making records unavailable in the system: One is to delete the record, the other is to de-activate the record. A de-activated record is not available for selection, but available for reports. There are two reasons for de-activating and not deleting records: (1) The system requires the record for audit purposes. (2) The record is referenced by other records. E.g., you cannot delete a Business Partner, if there are invoices for this partner record existing. You de-activate the Business Partner and prevent that this record is used for future entries.
